cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:e09.team: 021 - Kierland Commons - Sur La Table, 7122 E Greenway Parkway, Suite 100, Scottsdale, AZ 85254
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:e09.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Culinary Lead at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience by combining culinary expertise, business acumen, and teaching skills. This role supports the culinary program, drives sales, delivers a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and helps build and manage a high-performing culinary team. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Supports the recruitment, training, and ongoing development of a high-performing team to meet the culinary business needs. · Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture. · Provide in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensures an outstanding cooking class experience in every session by following provided recipes and game plans while holding employees accountable for quality and execution. · Work with store leadership to increase foot traffic and store engagement through cooking classes and private events. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist with driving sales growth by implementing strategies to enhance the culinary and retail business. · Analyze key performance metrics daily and leverage insights to optimize store performance. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. You will work closely with sales and business development to connect marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. Foster strong collaboration between marketing, sales, and business development to ensure shared priorities, clear targets, and measurable revenue impact. Lead sponsorships, expos, industry events, and strategic partnerships that increase market visibility and create new business opportunities. Strengthen the global brand presence by identifying emerging markets, channels, partnerships, and opportunities for expansion. Strong experience in iGaming, affiliate marketing, performance marketing, or closely related digital industries. Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C marketing strategies, particularly within fast-moving digital businesses. Proven success in performance marketing, marketing analytics, budget management, and optimizing campaigns for measurable ROI. Strong knowledge of SEO, PPC, CRM, content marketing, social media, email marketing, digital PR, and related growth channels. Demonstrated experience developing lead-generation and sales enablement strategies that contribute directly to business development. Strong leadership and people-management skills, with experience managing remote and cross-functional teams. Ability to combine creative brand thinking with strong commercial judgment and a data-driven approach. Excellent strategic planning, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. Hands-on experience with paid social, sponsorships, partnerships, expos, and industry events is an advantage. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and taking ownership of global marketing initiatives. Benefits Competitive salary with performance-related bonuses. jobgether-jobgether:lever:61380260-0b3f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Meta Ads Consultant based in Spain. As a Meta Ads Consultant, you’ll take ownership of paid social growth across Facebook and Instagram, helping scale acquisition in key European markets. You’ll shape the strategy from the ground up while remaining deeply involved in campaign execution and optimisation. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategic thinking with data-driven decision-making. You’ll work closely with senior marketing stakeholders in a small, agile, international environment. Your work will directly influence lead generation, brand awareness, customer acquisition, and return on advertising spend. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to make a measurable impact within a fast-growing business. It is particularly well suited to an entrepreneurial marketer who prefers action, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Develop and implement a full-funnel Meta advertising strategy tailored to key European markets and target audiences. Plan, launch, manage, monitor, and continuously optimise Facebook and Instagram campaigns focused on lead generation, awareness, and acquisition. Analyse campaign performance, identify trends and opportunities, and translate data into actionable optimisation initiatives. Own paid social performance and continuously improve efficiency, ROI, and overall campaign impact. Collaborate closely with senior product and marketing stakeholders to align paid social activity with broader growth objectives. Advise on and contribute to ad copy, creative concepts, visuals, and landing pages to maximise campaign performance. Prepare clear, insightful performance reports with practical recommendations for future improvements. Continuously test audiences, creatives, messaging, and campaign approaches to identify scalable growth opportunities. Requirements: Proven experience managing and scaling successful Meta advertising campaigns, ideally within startups, scale-ups, or similarly fast-paced environments. Strong expertise in Meta Ads Manager, audience targeting, campaign structure, creative testing, measurement, and performance optimisation. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and turn insights into concrete business actions. Hands-on mindset with the ability and willingness to move seamlessly between strategic planning and detailed campaign execution. Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented approach, with a strong bias toward action and experimentation. Comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and operating effectively within a small and agile team. Fluent English is required; Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or other European languages are considered an advantage. Ability to work effectively within GMT to GMT+3 time zones. Benefits: Opportunity to play a key role in a fast-growing scale-up with international ambitions. Significant ownership and autonomy over Meta advertising strategy and execution. Remote working environment with a small, ambitious, and collaborative team. Freedom to experiment, innovate, and directly influence growth. Competitive consultant compensation. Opportunity to work across multiple European markets and make a measurable commercial impact. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b26e1bb4-8efe-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Writer - PostgreSQL based in Spain. This is an opportunity to join a distributed open-source software team focused on PostgreSQL and related database technologies. You’ll own the creation of clear, accurate, and user-oriented technical documentation across the product lifecycle. Working closely with engineers, product managers, QA, and fellow technical writers, you’ll turn complex technical concepts into practical resources for diverse audiences. The role combines technical writing, documentation strategy, developer tooling, and hands-on exploration of database systems. You’ll work in a docs-as-code environment and use modern AI tools to improve the speed and quality of your work. With a high degree of autonomy, flexible working hours, and a global team, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys both deep technical work and collaborative open-source environments. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including installation and configuration guides, troubleshooting resources, how-to articles, user manuals, man pages, help prompts, and release documentation. Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, developers, QA specialists, and other technical writers to produce accurate, timely, and high-quality documentation. Translate complex PostgreSQL and database concepts into clear, accessible content for users with different levels of technical expertise. Use Markdown, text, images, diagrams, and other formats to create engaging and effective documentation. Work within a docs-as-code methodology, maintaining documentation through version-controlled workflows and contributing to scalable documentation practices. Leverage AI-powered tools to draft, refine, structure, format, and improve technical content while maintaining accuracy and quality. Participate actively in team ceremonies, technical discussions, planning sessions, and other collaborative activities. Contribute to the broader documentation strategy and continuously improve writing standards, workflows, and processes. Engage with open-source communities through forums, mailing lists, and other communication channels, sharing knowledge and gathering technical insights. Research new technologies and contribute to upstream documentation, technical blog content, or other knowledge-sharing initiatives when appropriate. Help develop and maintain automated documentation testing, validation processes, and CI/CD workflows where applicable. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience as a Technical Writer, with a proven ability to produce precise, high-quality technical documentation. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical subjects clearly and effectively. Experience documenting complex software systems and producing user-oriented documentation for technical audiences. Strong familiarity with markup languages, particularly Markdown. Hands-on experience installing and configuring database server software on Linux. Practical experience with docs-as-code methodologies and tools such as Git, Jenkins, Markdown, HTML, and/or JavaScript. Experience using AI tools to support technical documentation workflows. Comfortable working with the Linux command line and developer tools such as Git, GCC, and GDB. Understanding of distributed systems and/or database server development. Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively within a globally distributed organization. Strong collaboration skills and experience communicating through tools such as Slack, Jira, Notion, Zoom, mailing lists, and community forums. Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, solve problems independently, and contribute positively as part of a distributed team. A developer or DevOps background is highly valued. Experience contributing to PostgreSQL or other open-source

southparkcommons-meesho:lever:60e0d986-a.title: Software Development Engineer III DevOps
southparkcommons-meesho:lever:60e0d986-a.description: About the team DevOps - because even the best developers need heroes. Whether you agree or not, a Senior DevOps Engineer is definitely nothing less than a hero to us - and with good reason! When 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this – with zero downtime! 😎 Sounds impossible? Well, that’s the kind of Engineering muscle that has helped Meesho become the e-commerce giant that it is today. We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. We’ve taken steps to inculcate a strong ‘Founder’s Mindset’ across our engineering teams, making us grow and move fast. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication. As Senior DevOps Engineer, you will be part of self-starters who thrive on teamwork and constructive feedback. We know how to party as hard as we work! If we aren’t building unparalleled tech solutions, you can find us debating the plot points of our favourite books and games – or even gossipping over chai. So, if a day filled with building impactful solutions with a fun team sounds appealing to you, join us. About the role As DevOps Engineer with us, your primary responsibility will be to create systems that serve as the brains of complex distributed products. You will closely mentor younger engineers on the team. You will work on code modularity, scalability, reusability and contribute to team building in the Engineering org.
